import html from typing import List # Predefined template with placeholders for the post components. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The author's name. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : List[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string for embedding in a page. """ # Escape user-supplied content to prevent XSS and ensure well‑formedness. safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # body may contain HTML entities but we escape all. # Render tags as individual elements, each escaped. safe_tags = " ".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ) # Insert the sanitized parts into the template. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
